prompt: List each item in this RSS feed with its title, pubDate, and a one-sentence summary of the description. Limit to the most recent 20 items.

List each item in this RSS feed with its title, pubDate, and a one-sentence summary. This is Google's general official blog (not AI-specific) - it's here for company news (investments, policy, product launches across all of Google) that the AI-only blog misses. Limit to the most recent 15 items.

List each item in this RSS feed with its title, pubDate, and a one-sentence summary. This is Meta's official newsroom (not AI-specific) - it's here for general company news that the AI-only blog misses. Limit to the most recent 15 items.

List each item in this RSS feed with its title, pubDate, and a one-sentence summary - this is NVIDIA's developer blog, so favor items about APIs/SDKs (CUDA, TensorRT, NIM, cuDNN, etc.) if there are more than 20 items.

This is JSON row data from the LMArena (Chatbot Arena) text leaderboard's official Hugging Face dataset (lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset, config 'text', split 'latest'), already filtered to the 'overall' category and sorted by rank ascending. List each row's rank, model_name, organization and rating (round rating to the nearest integer).

List the 5 most recent releases with their version tag, date, and the actual feature/change bullet points from each changelog - not just 'version X released'. This is for people who want to know what changed, not just that something shipped.

This is the master JEP (JDK Enhancement Proposal) index - the actual language/JVM/API features being added to Java, independent of any one vendor's build. List the JEPs targeted to or delivered in the most recent 2-3 JDK feature releases, with JEP number, title, and status (Targeted/Delivered/Candidate/Preview).

List each item in this RSS feed with its title, pubDate, and a one-sentence summary. Limit to the most recent 15 items, and prioritize feature/language-change announcements (new version releases, PEPs, JIT/performance work) over routine patch-release notices if there isn't room for both.

This is the master PEP (Python Enhancement Proposal) index - the actual language/stdlib/C-API features being added to Python, the Python equivalent of Java's JEPs. List the PEPs targeted to or accepted/final for the most recent 1-2 Python feature releases, with PEP number, title, and status (Accepted/Final/Draft/Open/etc.).

This is the raw endoflife.date API for CPython: one object per minor version ('cycle', e.g. '3.12'), with releaseDate, eol, latest (current patch, e.g. '3.12.14' - NOT the same as the cycle), and latestReleaseDate. For every cycle, report: cycle, releaseDate, eol, latest, latestReleaseDate, and whether eol has already passed as of today. Do not collapse rows - list every cycle in the JSON.

This is the raw endoflife.date API for Oracle JDK: one object per major version ('cycle'), with releaseDate, eol (Premier Support end), extendedSupport (end date or false), latest (the current patch/update build, e.g. '17.0.20.1' or '8u452' - this is NOT the same as the major version), and latestReleaseDate (when that patch shipped). For every cycle, report: cycle, releaseDate, eol, extendedSupport, latest, latestReleaseDate, and whether eol has already passed as of today. Do not collapse rows - list every cycle in the JSON.

This is the raw endoflife.date API for Eclipse Temurin: one object per major version ('cycle'), with releaseDate, eol (support end), latest (the current patch/update build - NOT the same as the major version), and latestReleaseDate. For every cycle, report: cycle, releaseDate, eol, latest, latestReleaseDate, and whether eol has already passed as of today. Do not collapse rows - list every cycle in the JSON.

This is the raw endoflife.date API for Amazon Corretto: one object per major version ('cycle'), with releaseDate, eol (support end), latest (the current patch/update build - NOT the same as the major version), and latestReleaseDate. For every cycle, report: cycle, releaseDate, eol, latest, latestReleaseDate, and whether eol has already passed as of today. Do not collapse rows - list every cycle in the JSON.

List the most recent quarterly Critical Patch Update (CPU) advisories on this page with their date and link, especially anything mentioning Java SE - these are what fix the CVEs behind each 'latest' JDK patch build.

This is a table of NVIDIA's published CVEs for the current year. List the 15 most severe (highest CVSS, CRITICAL then HIGH) distinct entries with CVE ID, CVSS score/severity, affected product, and fixed-in version. Deduplicate rows that share the same CVE across product variants - note the product family once.

List the top 15 items in this RSS feed (title and link). This is the Hacker News front page - a general tech-industry pulse, not curated for any one topic. If there are more than 15, prioritize AI, Java/JVM, and security/infrastructure stories.
